rows.remaining: The probe verifies state-statistics output, a serialized tool allocation-state blob, tool status, and mutable DRED settings. Full DRED breadcrumb/page-fault output, debugger callbacks, pageable allocation tools, cache diagnostics, and cross-process corruption/restart evidence remain open.

InfoQueue1 callback registration, storage-filter suppression, ignore-filter delivery, and unregister lifecycle are covered. Cross-thread callback ordering, device-debug event sources, and complete DRED/tool callback integration remain open.
The DSR factory ABI and invalid-device output initialization are covered, but no DSR device IID or scaling execution provider is present; DSR is not advertised.
